requirement: at least two task families that no pretraining source ever touched (README §9.2, PLAN_SPEC datasets.ADAPT-HOLDOUT.min_clean_families = 2)
freeze_policy: the frozen pair is what W10 runs Z/A/S/A-ad on; it may not be re-picked after seeing results (that would turn the hold-out into development data)
a replacement may only be taken from 'reserved' and only through a new frozen registry revision that records the original family as unused
every family here is excluded from BOOTSTRAP/TACT/POWER/BC/DAgger/perception/reward/selection by pretraining_sources.json; the validator rejects a config where a pretraining source lists one of them

frozen.label: TH08 Hard / Stage 4A / Border Team (team 0)
frozen.why_clean: difficulty=2 never appears in any fitting source; stage 3 is Stage 4A; neither the human reference measurement nor any dev/confirm record covers Hard 4A

clean_evidence.claim: the canonical D1 teacher corpus never contains this difficulty
clean_evidence.observation: 147/147 D1 shards declare difficulty=1 and stage in 0..7; the difficulty set of the corpus is exactly {1}

clean_evidence.claim: every v4.1.0 / v4.2.0 training corpus is Normal stage 1 / team 0
clean_evidence.observation: all of them declare stage 0 (or stage=None with stage 0 rollout), difficulty normal/1 and team 0

clean_evidence.claim: no human-reference measurement covers this (difficulty, stage) pair
clean_evidence.observation: EXP-P0-046 measured only Normal stages 0,1,2,3,5,7 and Lunatic stages 0,1,2,4,5,7; human_reference.json lists coverage.missing

clean_evidence.claim: no development, candidate-selection or confirmation record uses it
clean_evidence.observation: dev/candidate seeds are 1000-1039 and the spent teacher confirmation batch is 61300-61399, all of them Normal stage 1

clean_evidence.claim: the pair appears only in the retail replay instrument, which fits no model
clean_evidence.observation: the 108-fixture retail corpus covers Easy/Normal/Hard/Lunatic x stages 0-7 plus Extra; replaying it verified harness traces only (G0.1). Any source that fits these frames must declare uses_retail_replay_fixtures=true and is then rejected by H_INSTRUMENT_FIXTURE_LEAK

instrument_exposure.note: the fixtures were replayed to verify the harness trace (G0.1); no gradient, label, reward model or selection rule consumed them

risks: difficulty shift: the whole pretraining corpus is Normal; a zero success rate for every arm is a live possibility and would make G410-6 evidence insufficient rather than passed
stage-script overlap: the stage layout/enemy waves exist at Normal in D1; the clean claim is difficulty-scoped, not stage-novel
if any future source fits the retail replay corpus, this family stops being clean (the corpus covers every (difficulty, stage) pair)
